map.CLSI 折点对照，输入MIC值自动判定敏感(S)/中介(I)/耐药(R): Compare CLSI breakpoints; enter MIC to auto-classify Susceptible (S)/Intermediate (I)/Resistant (R).
map.📖 查看「微生物药敏(MIC)折点对照器 使用指南」: View "Microbiology MIC Breakpoint Comparator User Guide"
map.按 CLSI M100（2023）标准将测得 MIC 与折点比对，判读敏感/中介: Compare measured MIC with CLSI M100 (2023) breakpoints to read S/I/R; for review only, medication is decided by infectious-disease and pharmacy.
map.• S 敏感(Susceptible)：MIC≤S折点，常规剂量可抑制: • S Susceptible: MIC ≤ S breakpoint, suppressible at standard dose
map.• I 中介(Intermediate)：MIC在S与R之间，需提高剂量或限制使: • I Intermediate: MIC between S and R, may need higher dose or restricted use
map.• R 耐药(Resistant)：MIC≥R折点，常规治疗失败风险高: • R Resistant: MIC ≥ R breakpoint, high risk of standard-therapy failure
map.折点因细菌-药物组合而异，本工具数据基于CLSI M100，临床以当地实验室报告: Breakpoints vary by organism-drug pair; this tool's data are based on CLSI M100; follow your local lab report clinically.
map.血/尿培养报出 MIC 后，按菌种与药物查对应折点判读 S/I/R。: After blood/urine culture reports MIC, look up the matching breakpoint by organism and drug to read S/I/R.
map.按 CLSI M100 折点表逐药对照，输出 S/I/R 判读。: Compare each drug against the CLSI M100 breakpoint table and output the S/I/R reading.
map.教学演示折点与 PK/PD 靶点（如 %fT>MIC）关系。: Teach the relation between breakpoints and PK/PD targets (e.g. %fT>MIC).
map.测得 MIC 0.06 μg/mL，对照本页 CLSI M100 大肠杆菌左氧氟: Measured MIC 0.06 μg/mL against this page's CLSI M100 E. coli levofloxacin breakpoint (S≤0.5, R≥4): classified S; if MIC is 8, then ≥4 gives R and a regimen switch is needed.
map.不一定，还需看感染部位浓度、患者免疫与 PK/PD；折点是群体概率，非个体保证。: Not necessarily; also consider site concentration, patient immunity and PK/PD; breakpoints are population probabilities, not individual guarantees.
map.CLSI 和 EUCAST 一样吗？: Are CLSI and EUCAST the same?
map.有差异，同一 MIC 可能判读不同。本页采用 CLSI M100 2023 折点: They differ, and the same MIC may read differently. This page uses CLSI M100 2023 breakpoints; reports should state the standard used.
map.不能，经验性/目标性用药由医师与临床药师综合决定，本工具仅做折点对照。: No, empirical/targeted therapy is decided by physician and clinical pharmacist; this tool only compares breakpoints.
map.关于「微生物药敏MIC折点对照器」: About the Microbiology MIC Breakpoint Comparator
map.微生物药敏 MIC 折点对照器。输入菌种、药物与测得 MIC，按 CLSI M1: An MIC breakpoint comparator. Enter organism, drug and measured MIC to read S/I/R per CLSI M100 (2023); for review only, medication by infectious-disease and pharmacy.
map.按所选细菌取折点表逐药判定：MIC ≤ S 折点判 S 敏感，MIC ≥ R 折: Uses the breakpoint table for the selected organism to interpret each drug: MIC ≤ S breakpoint = S (susceptible), MIC ≥ R breakpoint = R (resistant), and values in between = I (intermediate); the intermediate range is shown as >S and <R, or — when either side is missing; no interpretation is given when MIC is blank or breakpoints are missing; MIC must be positive and on the twofold dilution series (0.125, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4…, about ±8% tolerance), otherwise S/I/R is not output.
